# vendored: autodown-test-parser

Pinned snapshot of the AutoDown headless markdown block-tree parser used as
the structural judge (block semantics: headings / `^anchors` / fences) for
`auto-test-case` (Plan 768). Never edit the generated modules by hand;
regeneration is an explicit re-vendor + fingerprint update.

## Source

- Repository: `D:/autostack/auto-down` (read-only upstream; sibling pinned
  detached worktree `D:/autostack/.wt/lang-768/auto-down` during the plan)
- Git revision: `fba6563ed2148ce85e68208863159b4ccccac710` (clean tree)
- Upstream crate: `autodown/packages/engine/rust` (crate name `autodown-core`,
  `version = "0.1.0"`, zero dependencies, no unsafe)

## Closure (exactly these files, copied verbatim)

| File | SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| `src/markdown_parser.rs` | `4c41853517d09f4740ed32f3a6645f3fedd8bd7ad69ac0fd3ece16f21427ffc9` |
| `src/block_model.rs` | `8e99920ff0f078706ea7d8e8b2f351e3fe90c5220d57c791d6ca0e1000b04c36` |
| `src/ial.rs` | `085091486a36aac33079984401575dc0e9331377d87114a2ae44c5fcd8a46bfa` |

`serializer.rs`, `hljs_scope_map.rs`, `palette_map.rs`, `artifact_hash.rs`
are NOT part of the parser closure and are intentionally not vendored.

`src/lib.rs` (this snapshot's module wrapper) and this file are hand-written;
the three generated files carry their upstream
`// Auto-generated by a2r transpiler` headers unchanged.

## License

Upstream declares `license = "MIT"` in `engine/rust/Cargo.toml` but ships no
LICENSE text file and no per-file headers (gap recorded in
`docs/plans/attachments/768/feasibility.md` §1; both repositories belong to
the same owner). This snapshot keeps the MIT declaration.

## Fidelity guard

`crates/auto-test-case/tests/vendor_provenance.rs` re-hashes the three files
against the table above and fails on any drift.
